mapper.select: SELECT b.*, u.id AS creator_id, u.name AS creator_name, u.avatar AS creator_avatar, bm.role AS current_user_role FROM boards b LEFT JOIN users u ON b.creator = u.id LEFT JOIN board_members bm ON b.id = bm.board_id AND bm.member_id = #{userId} WHERE b.id = #{id}

SELECT b.id, b.name, b.cover FROM boards b
AND b.name LIKE concat('%', #{keyword}, '%')
